verdicts_or_reports.expected: No subtype selected until explicitly chosen; tapping Container resolves it and displays concentration and amount inputs.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Gel initially shows Container checked but no concentration/amount inputs. Tapping Container has no effect and Save silently stays on editor. Switching to Sachet and back reveals Container inputs.
steps: Tap Container; inputs remain missing; tap Save, nothing happens.
Select Sachet then Container; inputs appear.
Select Tablet then Gel and tap Container again; issue repeats.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Explicitly tapping Container displays Gel concentration (%) and Total gel amount (g).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: After choosing Gel and explicitly tapping Container, both required fields are absent. Container is shown checked. Selecting Sachet then Container makes the missing fields appear.
steps: From fresh Medicines list tap Add medicine.
Observe no Gel concentration (%) or Total gel amount (g) fields.
Tap Sachet, then Container: both fields now appear.
Switch Tablet then Gel and tap Container to reproduce.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: Explicitly selecting Ampule displays its strength input.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Injection shows Ampule checked, but no strength input. Tapping Ampule does not reveal it. Vial then Ampule reveals the input. This is also affected by the subtype issue reported for Gel.
steps: Open Add medicine with Estradiol selected.
Select Injection, tap Ampule: strength field absent.
Select Vial then Ampule: strength field appears.
Select Tablet then Injection and tap Ampule: absence repeats.
